instruction: その運用にしてみよう
approved_policy_change: when a work unit is completed, inspect Git state mechanically before starting the next work unit
if completed work remains uncommitted, remind the Human and block the next-work transition
do not classify ordinary in-progress dirty changes as completed uncommitted work
retain explicit Human commit authority during the pilot
not_authorized_or_required: amend, rebase, reset, or history rewrite
